# agentic-formats

Read and write open office files: ODF and OOXML for documents, spreadsheets, and slides.

Keywords: odf,ooxml,odt,ods,odp,docx,xlsx,pptx,office,documents,import,export,agents,mcp,cli.

- SDK: import { convert, inspect, readOdt, writeDocx } from "agentic-formats".
- CLI: agentic-formats convert in.odt out.docx. agentic-formats inspect in.docx.
- MCP: run agentic-formats mcp, then call inspect_file, read_model, or convert_file.
